evidence_plan.requirement: Does their NER model learn NER from both text and images?

payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the NER model integrates both text and images for learning, as it combines visual information with textual information to enhance performance.

claims.text: The NER model learns from both text and images by integrating visual information with textual information.
The proposed MNER model significantly outperforms text-only NER models by leveraging visual contexts.
